title: One of the Oldest Mars Meteorites Ever Found
paragraphs: Scientists studied a rock from Mars. It is called Teghaza 001. It fell to Earth long ago.
A person found it in the Sahara Desert in 2022. The rock is pink. It is very old, more than four billion years old.
The rock shows that Mars had water long ago. Scientists do not know where on Mars it came from. They want to learn more.

questions.q: Where did people find the rock?

questions.a: More than four billion years old.

questions.q: What did water do on Mars long ago?
questions.a: The rock shows Mars had water.
